in_marathi.name: Arockia
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arockia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arockia is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arohkah' which means 'shining light'. This name is often given to babies born under auspicious circumstances, symbolizing their innate ability to light up the lives of those around them.
